Digidrive Distributors, part of the RP–Sanjiv Goenka Group, is a technology-enabled B2B digital distribution company. The Company operates as a specialised master distributor, enabling brands to access leading digital marketplaces through an integrated platform covering inventory optimisation, order orchestration, marketplace management, logistics coordination and fulfilment. Its portfolio includes Saregama India’s iconic Carvaan music player.
